w_agent_dispositions.source: W2 item 2 — Garante fine, Citta Metropolitana di Sassari (EUR 12,000)
w_agent_dispositions.reason: Fails all three W-PD-1 limbs. Not on fire, not a cross-day pattern, and a EUR 12,000 fine against a single Italian metropolitan body is not a horizon shift changing defender obligations — unlike W30's BaFin/TeamViewer entry, which established that a nation-state breach at a listed vendor is inside information requiring formal multi-channel disclosure. Single-source on Garante's own newsletter and decision page with no independent pickup, and Garante is not on this deployment's carve-out list. Decisive test: a Tier 2/3 responder or detection engineer does nothing differently in the next seven days — GDPR Article 25 role-drift in an e-protocollo system is DPO and data-governance work. Doubt about relevance to this constituency resolves toward drop. No registry entity created.

planned_entries.lens: W-PD-1(a)+(b) — the exploited surface this week was the management plane of the security and infrastructure estate, and in every case the patch is not the remediation

W-PD-1(a)+(b) — water/wastewater PLC lockouts went from one state to seven inside the week, with European exposure quantified on a different vendor's controllers and attribution declined by every investigating body

W-PD-1(a)+(c) — two independently-operating Russian state clusters converged on the government user's mail and the government user's travel, both leaving persistence that a patch or password reset does not remove
W-PD-1(b) — every authentication bypass disclosed this week came from code accepting an attacker-supplied value as proof of identity; the check ran, it just validated the wrong thing

W-PD-1(b)+(c) — both standard prioritisation feeds failed in the same window: exploited flaws absent from KEV, and critical flaws with no fix to apply. Carries the OT dimension (Phoenix Contact, Desigo CC V7)
W31 per-CVE trajectory versus first coverage

W-PD-1(b) — in nearly every confirmed European public-sector incident this week the entry point was an already-valid credential and the attacker used the platform's own admin or export function; plus the FBI's shared-integrator homogeneity multiplier

W-PD-1(b) — criminal claims outran confirmation in every direction this week: a leak-site list assessed more likely fabricated than real that nonetheless contains one confirmed government breach, a blast-radius claim resting on a single outlet, an attribution the victim will not confirm

W-PD-1(b) — this week's tradecraft was engineered against the analyst's environment rather than the endpoint agent: samples that refuse to run without a keyed argument, loaders that cannot decrypt away from the host they infected, and operator activity indistinguishable from the victim's own session
